description: Evaluate whether the current repo state is safe for PR, merge, release, and publish operations.

baseBranch.description: Protected base branch to compare against (defaults to main)

command.description: Optional git, PR, or publish command to evaluate against the current governance state

requirePrForReleaseSensitive.description: When true, release-sensitive changes on non-base branches require an open PR

requireVersionNotBehindBase.description: When true, release-sensitive changes cannot lag behind the base branch package version

name: check_operational_integrity
title: Check Operational Integrity
